text: 猎人找来足够的绳子，把你们三人都捆起来，分别绑在树干上。他们做完神秘仪式后，便收拾简陋行装，离开这处地点。等了一会儿，你们开始挣扎着想要脱身。
你心里有一部分觉得这在专业上十分有趣。但若想发表研究成果，就必须挣脱束缚。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 566
text: The hunters produce enough cords to bind all three of you and then place you each against a tree and lash you to the trunk. Their mysterious work done, the outcasts pack up their simple gear and abandon the spot. You wait for a few minutes before beginning to struggle against your bonds.
A part of you finds this professionally fascinating. But you will have to get free if you wish to publish your findings.
